cues: Raised in quiet outer suburbs, they feel like visitors in a foreign land.
The Macedonians shout, the old Polish widower hammers nails into wood and pulls them out again, and a little boy urinates in the street.
The disapproval runs both ways: the neighbours frown at a wife who goes out to work while the husband stays home writing a thesis.
